# Project Context

- Repository: `jamesmontemagno/auto-github-changelog-poster`
- Source of truth for code: GitHub repository
- Source of truth for planning: Azure DevOps
- Azure DevOps organization: `devdiv-advocacy`
- Default Azure DevOps project for this repo: `Community Team Projects`

## Common Update Actions

- Self-assign a work item
- Move state between backlog and active work
- Add implementation comments
- Adjust priority or iteration after planning changes

## Reporting Back

After updating a work item, summarize:

- work item ID
- title
- fields changed or comment added
- project used
- any ambiguity that still needs user input
